result.description: Customer messaging and support platform (inbox, help desk, Fin AI agent, help center) with a REST API for contacts, conversations, tickets and more.
result.auth_detail: OAuth2 authorization-code flow is required for public apps that access other people's Intercom data (authorize at app.intercom.com/oauth, exchange code at api.intercom.io/auth/eagle/token). Private apps use a workspace access token sent as an Authorization: Bearer header.
result.access_detail: Free development workspace via public developer signup lets a developer build and publish a public OAuth app. Dev workspaces are US-only, limited in features, and can't be converted to production. Private apps (access token) target a paid workspace, and the docs don't name a plan tier. The docs don't mention an app review gate for connecting public apps.
